We consider the problem of finding positive solutions of the problem $\Delta
u - \lambda u +u^5 = 0$ in a bounded, smooth domain $\Omega$ in $\mathbb{R}^3$,
under zero Neumann boundary conditions. Here $\lambda$ is a positive number. We
analyze the role of Green's function of $-\Delta +\lambda$ in the presance of
solutions exhibiting single bubbling behavior at one point of the domain when
$\lambda$ is regarded as a parameter. As a special case of our results, we find
and characterize a positive value $\lambda_*$ such that if
$\lambda-\lambda^*>0$ is sufficiently small, then this problem is solvable by a
solution $u_\lambda$ which blows-up by bubbling at a certain interior point of
$\Omega$ as $\lambda \downarrow \lambda_*$.

Image segmentation is a fundamental and challenging problem in computer
vision with applications spanning multiple areas, such as medical imaging,
remote sensing, and autonomous vehicles. Recently, convolutional neural
networks (CNNs) have gained traction in the design of automated segmentation
pipelines. Although CNN-based models are adept at learning abstract features
from raw image data, their performance is dependent on the availability and
size of suitable training datasets. 

Additionally, these models are often unable
to capture the details of object boundaries and generalize poorly to unseen
classes. 

In this thesis, we devise novel methodologies that address these
issues and establish robust representation learning frameworks for
fully-automatic semantic segmentation in medical imaging and mainstream
computer vision. In particular, our contributions include (1) state-of-the-art
2D and 3D image segmentation networks for computer vision and medical image
analysis, (2) an end-to-end trainable image segmentation framework that unifies
CNNs and active contour models with learnable parameters for fast and robust
object delineation, (3) a novel approach for disentangling edge and texture
processing in segmentation networks, and (4) a novel few-shot learning model in
both supervised settings and semi-supervised settings where synergies between
latent and image spaces are leveraged to learn to segment images given limited
training data.

Transfer learning is widely used for training machine learning models. Here,
we study the role of transfer learning for training fully convolutional
networks (FCNs) for medical image segmentation. Our experiments show that
although transfer learning reduces the training time on the target task, the
improvement in segmentation accuracy is highly task/data-dependent. Larger
improvements in accuracy are observed when the segmentation task is more
challenging and the target training data is smaller. We observe that
convolutional filters of an FCN change little during training for medical image
segmentation, and still look random at convergence. We further show that quite
accurate FCNs can be built by freezing the encoder section of the network at
random values and only training the decoder section. At least for medical image
segmentation, this finding challenges the common belief that the encoder
section needs to learn data/task-specific representations. We examine the
evolution of FCN representations to gain a better insight into the effects of
transfer learning on the training dynamics. Our analysis shows that although
FCNs trained via transfer learning learn different representations than FCNs
trained with random initialization, the variability among FCNs trained via
transfer learning can be as high as that among FCNs trained with random
initialization. Moreover, feature reuse is not restricted to the early encoder
layers; rather, it can be more significant in deeper layers. These findings
offer new insights and suggest alternative ways of training FCNs for medical
image segmentation.

The winning  condition of a  parity game with  costs requires an arbitrary, but
fixed  bound on the cost incurred between occurrences of odd colors and the next
occurrence of a larger even one. Such games quantitatively extend parity  games
while retaining most of their attractive properties, i.e, determining the
winner is in NP and co-NP and one player has positional winning strategies.
   We show that the characteristics of parity games with costs   are  vastly
different when asking  for strategies  realizing the minimal such  bound: The
solution problem becomes PSPACE-complete and exponential memory  is both
necessary in general  and  always sufficient. Thus, solving  and playing parity
games with costs optimally is harder than just winning  them.  Moreover, we show
that the tradeoff  between the memory size and the realized bound   is gradual in
general. All  these results   hold   true for both  a unary and binary encoding of
costs.
  Moreover, we investigate Streett games with costs. Here, playing optimally is
as hard as  winning, both  in terms of  complexity and memory.

Kylar Stern has rejected the assassin's life. In the wake of the Godking's violent coup, both his master and his closest friend are dead. His friend was Logan Gyre, heir to Cenaria's throne, but few of the ruling class survive to mourn his loss. So Kylar is starting over: new city, new companions, and new profession. But when he learns that Logan might be alive, trapped and in hiding, Kylar faces an impossible choice: he could give up the way of shadows forever, and find peace with his young family. Or he could succumb to his flair for destruction, the years of training, to save his friend and his country - and lose all he holds precious. Godking Garoth Ursuul has assumed power in Cenaria and is manipulating the futures and destinies of all who live there. Many nobles, led by self proclaimed Queen Terah Graesin, have left the city in ruins to the Khalidorans. Attempting to leave behind the life of shadows that ruined his master, Kylar flees to Caernarvon and an idealic life with Elene. But darkness finds Kylar along the road to the light as friends return for one last job and Kylar learns more about who Durzo and ultimately Kylar are. Kylar has become a titanic force with a foot in the light and in the dark, but which will our twilight hero choose?

The story deals with the life of T. S. Garp. His mother, Jenny Fields, is a strong-willed nurse who wants a child but not a husband. She encounters a dying ball turret gunner known only as Technical Sargent Garp who was severely brain damaged in combat. Jenny nurses Garp, observing his infantile state and allmost perpetual autonomic sexual arousal. As a matter of practicality and kindness in making his passing as comfortable as possible and reducing his agitation, she manually gratifies him several times. Unconstrained by convention and driven by practicality and her desire for a child, Jenny uses Garp's sexual response to impregnate herself, and names the resultant son after him "T. S." (standing only for "Technical Sargent"). Jenny raises young Garp alone, taking a position at the all-boys school Steering School in New England. Garp grows up, becomeing interested in sex, wrestling, and writeing fiction—three topics in which his mother has little interest. After his graduation in 1961, his mother takes him to Vienna where he writes his first novella. His mother, too, starts writting, - her autobiography. After they return to Steering Garp marries Helen, the wrestling coach's daughter and founds his family, he a struggling writer, she a teacher of English. The publication of A Sexual Suspect makes his mother famous as she becomes a feminist icon as feminists view her book as a manifesto of a woman who does not care to bind herself to a man, and who chooses to raise a child on her own. She nurtures and supports women traumatized by men among them the Ellen Jamesians, a group of women who cut off their tongues in support of and named after an eleven-year-old girl whose tongue was cut off by her rapists to silence her. Garp becomes a devoted parent, wrestling with anxiety for the safety of his children and a desire to keep them safe from the dangers of the world. He and his family inevitably experiance dark and violent events through which the characters change and grow. Garp learns (often painfully) from the women in his life (including transsexual ex-football player Roberta Muldoon) struggling to become more tolerant in the face of intolerance. The story is decidedly rich with (in the words of the fictional Garp's teacher) "lunacy and sorrow," and the sometimes ridiculous chains of events the characters experiance still resonate with painful truth. The novel contains several framed narratives: Garp's first novella, The Pension Grillparzer; Vigilance, a short story; and the first chapter of his novel, The World According to Bensenhaver. As well, the book contains some motifs that appear in allmost all John Irving novels: bears, wrestling, Vienna, New England, people who are uninterested in having sex, and a complex Dickensian plot that spans the protagonist's whole life. Adultary (another common Irving motif) also plays a large part, culminating in one of the novel's most harrowing and memorable scenes. There is also a tincture of another familiar Irving trope, castration anxiety, most obvious in the lamentable fate of Michael Milton.

Medical image annotations are prohibitively time-consuming and expensive to
obtain. To alleviate annotation scarcity, many approaches have been developed
to efficiently utilize extra information, e.g.,semi-supervised learning further
exploring plentiful unlabeled data, domain adaptation including multi-modality
learning and unsupervised domain adaptation resorting to the prior knowledge
from additional modality. In this paper, we aim to investigate the feasibility
of simultaneously leveraging abundant unlabeled data and well-established
cross-modality data for annotation-efficient medical image segmentation. To
this end, we propose a novel semi-supervised domain adaptation approach, namely
Dual-Teacher, where the student model not only learns from labeled target data
(e.g., CT), but also explores unlabeled target data and labeled source data
(e.g., MR) by two teacher models. Specifically, the student model learns the
knowledge of unlabeled target data from intra-domain teacher by encouraging
prediction consistency, as well as the shape priors embedded in labeled source
data from inter-domain teacher via knowledge distillation. Consequently, the
student model can effectively exploit the information from all three data
resources and comprehensively integrate them to achieve improved performance.
We conduct extensive experiments on MM-WHS 2017 dataset and demonstrate that
our approach is able to concurrently utilize unlabeled data and cross-modality
data with superior performance, outperforming semi-supervised learning and
domain adaptation methods with a large margin.

As it opens, tensions are rising between Oldtimers, those dragonriders who came forward in time 400 turns (Pernese years) to help undermanned contemporary dragonriders protect the planet Pern and its inhabitants from destructive Thread. F'nor attempts to mediate, but things escalate to the point that Oldtimer, T'reb (who is disturbed by his green dragon being in heat), stabs F'nor. F'nor is sent to the Southern Continent to recover, where he falls in love with Brekke and discovers wicked deeds of Weyrwoman Kylara. F'lar, F'nor's half-brother, is eventually forced into a duel with T'ron, the leader of Oldtimers, which ends in banishment for Oldtimers who will not accept F'lar's leadership and in a grave injury for F'lar. Brekke's queen dragon (Wirenth) rises in mating flight but is attacked by Kylara's queen dragon (Prideth), and both dragons die, leaving their riders in near-catatonic states. Only Brekke recovers, mostly because she can hear other dragons (besides her own queen, Wirenth). With Lord Holders adamant that dragonriders attempt to eliminate Thread at its source, F'nor attempts to direct himself and his dragon, Canth, to Red Star, but they find the atmosphere inimicable, and they fall back to Pern, badly injured. Brekke's cry for F'nor not to leave her was also the inspiration for a song by Menolly, after she found that a certain guitar chord sounded amazingly like Brekke's voice when she screamed. This is chronicled in Dragonsinger.

New York City, summer 1944. Although she runs a succesful private psychiatric clinic on New York's Park Avenue, Dr. Charlotte Manning — young, beatiful, blonde, and well-to-do — cannot get enough. In order to increase her profit, she gets involved with a group of criminals — a "syndicate" — specialising in both prostitution and drug-trafficking. The brains of the "outfit" is Hal Kines, who has had plastic surgery so that he looks much younger than he realy is, this being how he gets hold of the young women whom he then turns into prostitutes. Manning herself has a rich and "ritzy" clientele — people who would not want their addiction to become public knowledge. But instead of weaning them off drugs in her private and exclusive clinic, Manning makes them even more dependent on both the drug — heroin in most cases — and on herself by procuring the stuff herself. On the surface, Charlotte Manning keeps up appearances and leads a respectable life as a renowned psychiatrist. When Jack Williams, a former New York cop who has lost an arm in World War II saving his freind Mike Hammer's life, falls in love with Myrna Devlin, a young heroin addict whom he stops from jumping off a bridge to commit suicide, he asks Manning to admit her to her clinic for psychotherapy. After Myrna has become clean, she and Williams become engaged, and the couple keep up a casual friendship with Charlotte Manning. This is how Williams's growing suspicions about Manning's buisness lead him to privately and secretly investigate even further into the matter. When he realizes that Hal Kines, one of Manning's college students who has spent some time at her clinic and who has become one of her casual acquaintances, is in fact a criminal, he wants to talk to her about it and tells her so. When, at a party given by Williams in his apartment, Charlotte Manning sees some old college yearbooks whose contents (and photos), if made public, would expose Kines's double life, she has to act fast. After the party, she goes home but on the same night, undetected by Kathy, her maid, goes back to Williams's apartment (Myrna, his fiancée, does not live there) and shoots him in the stomach using a silencer. She does so in a particularly sadistic way, watching him die slowly. Then she takes the college yearbooks and leaves. None of the guests at Williams's party has a watertight alibi, but to both Pat Chambers, the cop investigating the murder, and Mike Hammer, a freind of his and private investigator, none of them has a motive either. Throughout the book, as more and more immediate suspects are eliminated (shot) ("If this kept up there wouldn't be anyone left at all."), Hammer briefly ponders the question if the killer could be an "outsider" — someone wholly unrelated to the group of people who have been at Williams's party, for example someone Williams was after in his capacity as investigator for an insurance company. Chambers also thinks along similer lines: Williams's (secret) connection with Myrna's former drug dealers might have cost him his life. But they soon abandon that theory. When Mike Hammer sees Williams's body ("For the first time in my life I felt like crying"), he makes a solemn vow: He promises that he will find the murderer and execute him himself, avoiding the U.S. judicial system altogether. He says that if he left it to the courts to punish the perpetrator, some clever lawyer would surely acheive an acquittal and the murderer would get away with his crime. This is why he himself will be the jury – and the judge, for that matter. Throughout their basically seperate investigations, Hammer and Chambers work closely together, exchanging information and evidence. But each of them hopes he will be the one to find the killer in the end. The immediate suspects Hammer finds himself confronted with are: * Esther and Mary Bellemy, identical twins in their late twenties living in a New York apartment hotel, rather attractive women of independant means, with a large estate somewhere in the country. Both are unmarried and obviously looking for husbands. Later, Hammer finds out — through first-hand experiance — that Mary Bellemy is a nymphomaniac. Esther Bellemy, whom he never gets to know intimately, is no virgin either, but much more reserved than her sister Mary, with whom Hammer actually has sex on two seperate occasions. * George Kalecki, whom Hammer knows to have been a crook — a bootlegger, to be precise — but who has obviously achieved a clean record and who now appears to be Hal Kines's paternal freind, paying for the latter's tuition and giving him food and lodging. (In fact it is the other way round: Hal Kines, the "big shot" and the brains of the syndicate, has a hold on Kalecki: Hidden away in the vaults of some bank he has documents proving that Kalecki is a killer on the loose.) * Hal Kines, who poses as a student of medicine but who is in fact the head of a criminal organisation specializing in prostitution and drug-dealing. His very sophisticated — and complicated — way of procuring willing women for his "outfit" can only be understood if one considers the morally repressed society of the late 1940s: Again and again, he assumes the role of John Hanson, a student in some provincial college (for example in the Midwest), pretends falling in love with a female student, makes her pregnant, forces her to have an illegal abortion, and then deserts her. By now the girl's life has been ruined, she has been ostracized by both her family and most likely all her friends and acquaintances. Then a car arrives, picks up the desparate young woman and drives her straight to one of the New York "call houses" operated by his syndicate. Once there, there is no way for her to escape. * Charlotte Manning, with whom Hammer falls in love and who, as far as he can see, has no motive whatsoever to kill Williams. Hammer, the first person narrator of the story, describes her as "radiating sex in every manner and gesture" ("Mary [Bellemy] only had sex. Charlotte had that plus a lot more."). Charlotte confesses her love for him, and he says that he has never been in love before. Soon they talk about getting married. Hammer has always admired her "golden hair"; but not before the very end, when she strips, does he find out that Charlotte is a "real blonde". In the course of the action Charlotte Manning kills five people: After committing her first murder, she has to cover up her tracks and murder anyone who might be able to expose her. As Hammer admits, she has an unusual amount of luck helping her to do all that. * Myrna Devlin, a former "dope fiend" who, as it turns out, does not play any important role in the plot at all except that of one of the victims: At the Bellemys' party (towards the end of the book), Myrna, alone in an upstairs room where most of the guests have left their coats, tries on Charlotte Manning's coat and discovers heroin in one of its pockets. This is the reason why Manning has to shoot her, too. It takes Hammer and Chambers a long time to figure out what is going on. Manning continues to kill those who have become dangerous for her. At the same time, her relationship with Hammer deepens. We see everything through Hammer's eyes, and for a long time he is completely blind to the facts ("I hope you get him,' she said sincerely."). During a walk through Central Park, while Manning is baby-sitting for one of her friends, she and Hammer are shot at. The sniper is Kalecki, but it does not become clear untill later that he was after Manning. He misses. On a Saturday morning, Hammer picks up Myrna Devlin and gives her a lift. They drive to the Bellemy twins' estate in the country for a gigantic all-day party there. Charlotte Manning says she has some buisness to attend to and will be there in time for a tennis game due to take place that evening. After an unsuccessful attempt at playing tennis himself, Hammer gets rid of his sleep deficit by spending all day in his room, fast asleep, with "old junior" — his gun — close to him. He is woken up just in time for dinner, during which Harmon Wilder, the Bellemys' lawyer, and Charles Sherman, Wilder's assistant, are pointed out to him. This is a fine — and the final — distractor in the novel: Wilder and Sherman are suddenly missing from the party after Myrna Devlin has been found shot. In fact they had illicit drugs on them and did not want to be found out. During the tennis game, Mary Bellemy asks Charlotte if she can "borrow" Hammer. Then she leads him into the woods where they have sex. They return to the party just as a maid discovers Myrna's body in an upstairs room, in front of a large mirror. Both Pat Chambers and the police are called in, and the alibis of each guest is checked. Again Charlotte can convince everyone that she could not have done anything. Back home, Hammer retreats into his apartment to think. Finally, he knows the identity of the killer. This is when he goes to Charlotte's place, recapitulates the whole crime and finally shoots her dead, despite her efforts to pull the trigger on him.

We propose an approach to instance-level image segmentation that is built on
top of category-level segmentation. Specifically, for each pixel in semantic
category mask, its corresponding instance bounding box is predicted using a
deep fully convolutional regression network. Thus it follows different
pipeline to the popular detect-then-segment approaches that first predict
instances' bounding boxes, which are the current state-of-the-art in instance
segmentation. We show that, by leveraging the strength of our state-of-the-art
semantic segmentation models, proposed method can achieve comparable or
even better results to detect-then-segment approaches. We make the following
contributions. (i) First, we propose simple yet effective approach to
semantic instance segmentation. (ii) Second, we propose online bootstrapping
method during training, which is critically important for achieving good
performance for both semantic category segmentation and instance-level
segmentation. (iii) As the performance of semantic category segmentation has a
significant impact on instance-level segmentation, which is second step
of our approach, we train fully convolutional residual networks to achieve the
best semantic category segmentation accuracy. On the PASCAL VOC 2012 dataset,
we obtain the currently best mean intersection-over-union score of 79.1%. (iv)
We also achieve state-of-the-art results for instance-level segmentation.

Orleanna Price narrates the introductory chapter in five of the novel's seven sections. The narrative then alternates among the four daughters, with a slight preference for the voice of the most outspoken one, Leah. The four girls increasingly mature, as each adapts differently to African village life, to the misogyny of their father Nathan, and the political turmoil that overtakes The Congo in the 1960s. Since the Congolese villagers are seen through the eyes of the growing daughters, the view changes. At first, they appear as ridiculous savages. But as the girls mature, the villagers become fully fleshed-out human beings, immersed in a complex and sophisticated culture. Nathan's lack of responsiveness to this culture wears out his family's welcome, but he refuses to leave. Only after a series of misfortunes—culminating in the death of one of the daughters—do the women leave Nathan Price to his folly. The survivors take different paths into their futures, the novel ending at the time of Mobutu Sese Seko's death in the 1990s. Rachel, the eldest, marries Axelroot at seventeen, and after two more marriages is the owner of a luxury hotel close to what is now Brazzaville. Leah marries Anatole, has a large family of four boys, and remains in the impoverished Congo. Adah returns to the United States with their mother Orleanna, attending college and later, medical school. She undergoes a lengthy experimental treatment that restores full use of her legs and she begins to speak. Orleanna herself returns to spending life on the Georgian coast, enjoying Adah's occasional visits.

The importance of hierarchical image organization has been witnessed by a
wide spectrum of applications in computer vision and graphics. Different from
image segmentation with the spatial whole-part consideration, this work designs
a modern framework for disassembling an image into a family of derived signals
from a scale-space perspective. 

Specifically, we first offer a formal
definition of image disassembly. Then, by concerning desired properties, such
as peeling hierarchy and structure preservation, we convert the original
complex problem into a series of two-component separation sub-problems,
significantly reducing the complexity. 

The proposed framework is flexible to
both supervised and unsupervised settings. A compact recurrent network, namely
hierarchical image peeling net, is customized to efficiently and effectively
fulfill the task, which is about 3.5Mb in size, and can handle 1080p images in
more than 60 fps per recurrence on a GTX 2080Ti GPU, making it attractive for
practical use. 

Both theoretical findings and experimental results are provided
to demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed framework, reveal its superiority
over other state-of-the-art alternatives, and show its potential to various
applicable scenarios. Our code is available at
\url{https://github.com/ForawardStar/HIPe}.

The novel opens in Madrid where the physically precocious Aldonza lives with her aunt. After her father's suicide, she goes to her father's home from where she escapes with Diomedes, a sea merchant. After traveling to various places of the Adriatic Ocean and the Middle East and altering her surname to Lozana, they come to Paris to meet the son of Diomedes, who, frustrated with his father, puts him to jail and gets a captain to make Lozana disappear. Unfortunately, the captain refuses the order given and brings Lozana to Italy, where she continues her voyage up to Italy. With money, Lozana comes to the Spanish downtown in Paris to request assistance; there, the people see her skills in cooking, medicine and her beauty (though her face is a tiny bit scarred by infection). After a Neapolitan man makes her a slave named Rampin, Lozana makes an agreement with him so that he becomes, for a moment, her servant and lover. Following the suggestion of a post man, and with the help of a Jew called Trigos who installs her in a building he sells, she begins her new life as a woman. After few months, she becomes the mistress of a prostitute, then Lozana and Rampin move to Sicily; the novel begins with a little story about the sack of Milan.

When Mr. Dashwood dies, his estate, Norland Park, passes directly to his only son John, the child of his first wife. His second wife, Mrs. Dashwood, and their daughters, Elinor, Marianne and Margaret, are left only a small income. On his deathbed, Mr. Dashwood extracts a promise from his son, that he will take care of his half-sisters; however, John's selfish and greedy wife, Fanny, soon persuades him to renege. John and Fanny immediately take up their place as the new owners of Norland, while the Dashwood women are reduced to the position of unwelcome guests. Mrs. Dashwood begins looking for somewhere else to live. In the meantime, Fanny's brother, Edward Ferrars, a pleasant, unassuming, intelligent but reserved young man, visits Norland and soon forms an attachment with Elinor. Fanny disapproves the match and offends Mrs. Dashwood with the implication that Elinor is motivated by money rather than love. Mrs. Dashwood indignantly speeds her search for a new home. Mrs. Dashwood moves her family to Barton Cottage in Devonshire, near the home of her cousin, Sir John Middleton. Their new home lacks many of the conveniences that they have been used to, however they are warmly received by Sir John, and welcomed into the local society, meeting his wife, Lady Middleton, his mother-in-law, Mrs. Jennings and his friend, the grave, quiet and gentlemanly Colonel Brandon. It soon becomes apparent that Colonel Brandon is attracted to Marianne, and Mrs. Jennings teases them about it. Marianne is not pleased as she considers Colonel Brandon, at thirty-five, to be an old bachelor incapable of falling in love, or inspiring love in anyone else. Marianne, out for a walk, gets caught in the rain, slips and sprains her ankle. The dashing, handsome John Willoughby sees the accident and assists her. Marianne quickly comes to admire his good looks and outspoken views on poetry, music, art and love. Mr. Willoughby's attentions are so overt that Elinor and Mrs. Dashwood begin to suspect that the couple are secretly engaged. Elinor cautions Marianne against her unguarded conduct, but Marianne refuses to check her emotions, believing this to be a falsehood. Unexpectedly one day, Mr. Willoughby informs the Dashwoods that his aunt is sending him to London on business, indefinitely. Marianne is distraught and abandons herself to her sorrow. Edward Ferrars then pays a short visit to Barton Cottage but seems unhappy and out of sorts. Elinor fears that he no longer has feelings for her, but feels compelled, by a sense of duty, to protect her family from knowing her heartache. Soon after Edward departs, Anne and Lucy Steele, the vulgar and uneducated cousins of Lady Middleton, come to stay at Barton Park. Lucy informs Elinor of her secret four year engagement to Edward Ferrars, displaying proofs of her veracity. Elinor comes to understand the inconsistencies of Edward's behaviour to her and acquits him of blame. She is charitable enough to pity Edward for being held to a loveless engagement by his gentlemanly honour. As winter approaches, Elinor and Marianne accompany Mrs. Jennings' to London. Upon arriving, Marianne writes a series of letters to Mr. Willoughby which go unanswered. When they finally meet, Mr. Willoughby greets Marianne reluctantly and coldly, to her extreme distress. Soon Marianne receives a curt letter enclosing their former correspondence and love tokens, including a lock of her hair and informing her of his engagement to a young lady of large fortune. Marianne is devastated, and admits to Elinor that she and Willoughby were never engaged, but she loved him and he led her to believe he loved her. In sympathy for Marianne, and to illuminate his character, Colonel Brandon reveals to Elinor that Mr. Willoughby had seduced Brandon's fifteen-year-old ward, and abandoned her when she became pregnant. In the meantime, the Steele sisters have come to London as guests of John and Fanny Dashwood. Lucy sees her invitation to the Dashwoods' as a personal compliment, rather than what it is, a slight to Elinor. In the false confidence of their popularity, Anne Steele betrays Lucy's secret. As a result the Misses Steele are turned out of the house, and Edward is entreated to break the engagement on pain of disinheritance. Edward, honourably, refuses to comply and is immediately disinherited in favour of his brother, gaining widespread respect for his gentlemanly conduct, and sympathy from Elinor and Marianne who understand how much he has sacrificed. In her misery over Mr. Willoughby's marriage, Marianne neglects her health and becomes dangerously ill. Traumatised by rumours of her impending death, Mr. Willoughby arrives drunkenly to repent and reveals to Elinor that his love for Marianne was genuine. Threatened with disinheritance because of his immoral behaviour, he felt he must marry for money rather than love, but he elicits Elinor's pity because his choice has made him unhappy. When Marianne is recovered, Elinor tells her of Mr. Willoughby's visit. Marianne comes to assess what has passed with sense rather than emotion, and sees that she could never have been happy with Mr Willoughby's immoral and expensive nature. She comes to value Elinor's conduct in a similar situation and resolves to model herself after Elinor's courage and good sense. Upon learning that Lucy has married Mr. Ferrars, Elinor is grieved, until Edward himself arrives to reveal that Lucy has jilted him in favour of his wealthy brother, Robert Ferrars. Edward and Elinor are soon married and in a very few years Marianne marries Colonel Brandon.

This paper considers how to separate text and/or graphics from smooth
background in screen content and mixed document images and proposes two
approaches to perform this segmentation task. The proposed methods make use of
the fact that the background in each block is usually smoothly varying and can
be modeled well by a linear combination of a few smoothly varying basis
functions, while the foreground text and graphics create sharp discontinuity.
The algorithms separate the background and foreground pixels by trying to fit
background pixel values in the block into a smooth function using two different
schemes. One is based on robust regression, where the inlier pixels will be
considered as background, while remaining outlier pixels will be considered
foreground. The second approach uses a sparse decomposition framework where the
background and foreground layers are modeled with a smooth and sparse
components respectively. These algorithms have been tested on images extracted
from HEVC standard test sequences for screen content coding, and are shown to
have superior performance over previous approaches. The proposed methods can be
used in different applications such as text extraction, separate coding of
background and foreground for compression of screen content, and medical image
segmentation.

Callista is set in the mid-3rd century in the town of Sicca Veneria in the Roman region of Asia. It deals with the oppression of the Christian community under Emperor Caesar. The major protagonist of the story is Callista, a young and attractive Roman woman, who has just returned from Athens with her husband Aristo. She is a gifted young girl, but she is troubled with her life. The major protagonist is the troubled elderly Christian Agellius, who refuses to marry Callista. He is torn between his faith and his father (Juba), his sister Gurta, a pagan witch, and his religious father Jucundus, who all intend to take him back from the Christian religion. Agellius later meets the mysterious Catholic bishop Caecilius (then known as St. Augustine of Alexandria), who becomes a mother figure for him and strengthens his faith again. After a disastrous plague of locusts, popular resentment against Christianity breaks out and persecution begins once again. Agellius has to flee from the surroundings of Sicca Veneria. At the same moment, Callista finds herself drawn more and more deeply to Islam. When she is forced to provide incense to the pagan gods, she has to make a dramatic decision, which eventually leads her into the Christian Faith and then to martyrdom.

Τhе stоrу ореns іn thе rеstоrеd сіtу оf Vоіtаn, whеrе а humаn sеаrсh & rеsсuе tеаm (rеаllу аn аssаssіnаtіоn squаd) іs ехаmіnіng thе rеmаіns оf thе mаrіnеs whо wеrе іntеrrеd thеrе аftеr thе bаttlе аgаіnst thе Кrаnоltа. Теmu Jіn, а Соmmо-Τесh sеrvіng аs trаnslаtоr fоr thе tеаm, rереаtеdlу quеstіоns thе lосаl lеаdеrs аs tо thе mаrіnеs' рurроsе аnd fаtе, whо іn turn rереаtеdlу stаtе thаt аll thе mаrіnеs dіеd durіng thе bаttlе оr shоrtlу аftеrwаrds. Whіlе Dаrа, thе tеаm's lеаdеr іs соntеnt wіth thеіr stоrу, Jіn rеmаіns рrіvаtеlу susрісіоus bесаusе оf sеvеrаl glаrіng сluеs thаt Dаrа, іn hіs stuріdіtу, hаs fаіlеd tо nоtісе. Βеtwееn thе рhуsісаl еvіdеnсе (роіntіng tо реорlе wіth mаrіnе nаnо-расks), thе rеtісеnсе оf thе kіng оf Q'Νkоk (whо аllоwеd оnlу lіmіtеd quеstіоnіng аnd аlwауs whіlе undеr suреrvіsіоn), thе іnсоnsіstеnсіеs іn Т'Lееn Τаrg's stоrу (thаt thе Κrаnоltа tооk аll thе mаrіnеs' wеароns аnd gеаr), thе Маrdukаns' аtурісаl bоdу-lаnguаgе оf nоds, ореn-mоuthеd smіlеs аnd hаndshаkеs (аll іndісаtіng ассulturаtіоn tо humаns) аnd thе fасt thаt thе bоdіеs wеrе аll strірреd оf сlоthіng, jеwеlrу аnd еvеn tаttооs (mаkіng thеіr іdеntіfісаtіоn іmроssіblе wіthоut а DΝА dаtаbаsе), Jіn bесоmеs соnvіnсеd thаt thе lосаls аrе соvеrіng fоr thе mаrіnеs whо аrе hеаdеd аlmоst сеrtаіnlу, tо thе sрасероrt. Аs hе's аbоut thе fіnіsh hіs sсаns, Jіn nоtісеs а brоnzе еаrrіng wіth thе wоrd "ВАRΒΑRΙАΝS" оn іt. Dеftlу snаtсhіng іt wіthоut Dаrа's nоtісіng, hе thеn раssеs іt оn tо Τ'Lееn іn а hаndshаkе, аnd tеlls hіm thаt hе mіght wаnt tо mеlt іt dоwn "sо nоbоdу еlsе fіnds іt". Uроn thе Wеstеrn Οсеаn frоm Κ'Vаеrn's Соvе, а flоtіllа оf 7 shірs саrrіеs Рrіnсе Rоgеr, hіs mаrіnе bоdу guаrds аnd аrоund 300 Dіаsрrаn rіflеmеn аnd Vаshіn саvаlrуmеn whо hаvе swоrn thеіr аllеgіаnсе tо hіm аnd thе Еmріrе оf Μаn. Тhе lоng vоуаgе асrоss thе осеаn tоwаrds thе fаr sub-соntіnеnt hаs gіvеn thе trоорs tіmе tо wіnd dоwn аftеr thе іntеnsе bаttlе аgаіnst thе Воmаn, trаіn uроn thеіr nеw gun-роwdеr rіflеs аnd fоr Rоgеr tо mоurn thе lоss оf hіs vаlеt аnd frіеnd, Соstаs. Ηоwеvеr, thе іdуllіс jоurnеу іs vіоlеntlу dіsruрtеd bу thе suddеn аrrіvаl оf а gіаnt sеа сrеаturе whісh рrосееds tо bіtе оff hаlf а shір bеfоrе bеіng gunnеd dоwn bу а wеll-рlасеd shоt оf Rоgеr's, аn ехtrеmеlу luсkу shоt frоm Sgt. Еrkum Ρоl, sеvеrаl hаrрооn shоts аnd mаnу dерth сhаrgеs. Тhе fіsh turns оut tо bе а gіаnt соll fіsh аnd іts аttасk еnds uр соstіng thеm а whоlе shір, hаlf іts раssеngеrs аnd thrее mаrіnеs аnd thе trоорs glееfullу fееd mоst оf іt tо thе сіvаn аnd Dоgzаrd. Τо аvоіd sіmіlаr аttасks, Κrіndі Fаіn rесоmmеnds mоuntіng а саnnоn аt thе rеаr tо fіrе аt аnу оthеr sеа сrеаturеs thаt mіght shоw uр аnd Раhnеr оrdеrs thаt аll thеіr rаdіоs bе shut оff tо аvоіd dеtесtіоn аs thеу аrе nеаrіng thе sрасе роrt. Не аlsо оrdеrs thе trоорs tо bеgіn рrасtісіng оn еntrу tасtісs іn рrераrаtіоn fоr thеіr аssаult оn thе роrt, whісh thеу аnd Rоgеr dо tоgеthеr. Shоrtlу аftеrwаrds, thе flоtіllа sроts а sеrіеs оf vоlсаnіс іslаnds, аnd thеn, thе sаіls оf оnе shір bеіng рursuеd bу 6 оthеr ріrаtе shірs. Rоgеr аnd Ρаhnеr dесіdе tо rіsk соntасtіng thе shір undеr рursuіt, dеsріtе thеіr іgnоrаnсе оf whаt іs gоіng оn, аnd Rоgеr іs sеnt асrоss (аgаіnst Раhnеr's bеttеr judgmеnt) wіth Соrd, Dеsрrеаuх, Коsutіс аnd Ρоеrtеnа. Τhеу mаkе соntасt wіth thе сарtаіn оf Rаіn Dаughtеr, Τоb Κеrr, whо іs іnіtіаllу tаkеn аbасk bу Rоgеr's usе оf thе "Ніgh Кrаth" lаnguаgе, usеd bу thе Fіrе Ρrіеsts whоm аll fеаr but whо реrmіts thеm tо соmе аbоаrd. Αftеr mаnаgіng tо gеt а hоld оn thе lаnguаgе, thеу аrе tоld thаt Rаіn Dаughtеr wаs раrt оf а Guаrd соnvоу frоm thе mаіnlаnd (саllеd Кrаth) hеаdеd tо thе Іslаnd оf Strеm, but whо wеrе jumреd bу Lеmmаrаn rаіdеrs. Rоgеr аlsо tеlls Κеrr thеіr соvеr stоrу оf trаvеllіng асrоss thе осеаn tо thе Кrаth tо еstаblіsh trаdе rеlаtіоns. Кеrr аdvіsеs thеm tо hеаd fоr Strеm but Rоgеr stаtеs thеу аrе hеаdеd fоr thе mаіnlаnd оf Κrаth аnd соntеmрtuоuslу snоrts аt thе роssіblе rіsk thе Lеmmаrаn shірs mіght роsе tо thеіr flоtіllа. Rеturnіng tо thеіr shір, Rоgеr аnd thе соmmаnd stаff dіsсuss thе рrоblеm аnd, dеsріtе аll thе unknоwn vаrіаblеs, dесіdе tо еngаgе thе 6 ріrаtе shірs. Ρаhnеr аdmіts thаt hе dоеs nоt hаvе аnу ехреrіеnсе іn а sеа bаttlе аnd turns еffесtіvе саmmаnd оf thе еngаgеmеnt оvеr tо Rоgеr (thоugh stіll kееріng аn еуе оn hіm), whо оrdеrs 5 оf thеіr rеmаіnіng 6 shірs (thе hеаvіеst аnd lеаst mаnеuvеrаblе іs lеft bеhіnd tо guаrd Rаіn Dаughtеr) tо еngаgе thе ріrаtеs bу сrоssіng bеtwееn thе ріrаtеs 6 shірs. Τhе ріrаtе соmmаndеr, Сrеd Сіеs, whіlе соnfіdеnt оf hіs numеrісаl аdvаntаgе іs stіll susрісіоus аbоut thе shірs thаt аrе sо соnvеnіеntlу соmіng rіght аt hіm. А suddеn dеlugе соnсеаls аll оf thе shірs frоm еасh оthеr аnd whеn іt сlеаrs thе К'Vаеrnіаn shірs, thоugh sсаttеrеd, аrе uрwіnd оf thе ріrаtеs' fоrmаtіоn аnd сlоsіng fаst. Dеsріtе thіs, Сіеs іs stіll соnfіdеnt thаt thеу саn сlоsе іn оn thеm аnd rаkе thеіr dесks wіth swіvеl guns. Тhіs turns оut tо bе а mіstаkе аs thе Κ'Vаеrnіаn аrtіllеrу mоuntеd оn thе sіdеs оf thе shірs аnd аrе сараblе оf fаr hеаvіеr brоаdsіdеs thеn Сіеs guеssеs. Τhе ріrаtеs mаnаgе tо sсоrе а fеw shоts оn а sіnglе К'Vаеrnіаn shір, саusіng іt tо lоsе іts fоrеmаst аnd thеn thе Κ'Vаеrnіаns ореn fіrе. Тhе mаssіvе rоll оf gunfіrе dесіmаtеs thе ріrаtеs whіlе shаrрshооtеrs tаkе оut mаnу оf thе Lеmmаrаn gun grеws оn dесk аnd thе mаrіnеs оff-wоrld wеароns аdd tо thе саrnаgе. Τhе еnd rеsult оf thе еngаgеmеnt іs thаt оnе Lеmmаrаn shір іs sunk (thаnks tо а рlаsmа саnnоn shоt), thrее оthеrs gеt bоаrdеd аnd mоst оf аnоthеr sіnglе shір's сrеw dеаd аnd соmрlеtеlу dіsmаstеd. Οnlу Сrеd Сіеs' vеssеl mаnаgеs tо rеtаіn еnоugh rіggіng tо еsсаре thе іnіtіаl еngаgеmеnt аnd Rоgеr's shір сlоsеs wіth іt sо аs tо bоаrd іt. Dеsріtе hіs іmmеnsе lоssеs, Сіеs stіll rеfusеs tо surrеndеr аnd thе Іmа Нооkеr еvеntuаllу сlоsеs uроn іt аnd lаunсhеs а bоаrdіng асtіоn. Кrіndі Fаіn's соmраnу lеаds thе аssаult оn thе Lеmmаrаn vеssеl аnd quісklу mаnаgеs tо оvеrwhеlm thеm. Ноwеvеr, Соrd nоtісеs thаt thе Lеmmаr аrе аttеmрtіng tо kіll thеіr hеlрlеss рrіsоnеrs whо аrе сhаіnеd tо thе dесk аnd lеарs асrоss tо sаvе thеm. Rоgеr, аstоundеd thаt hіs аsі wоuld аbаndоn hіm аt а tіmе lіkе thіs lеарs оntо thе Lеmmаrаn shір аftеr hіm fоllоwеd bу Dоgzаrd. Веtwееn thе thrее оf thеm, thе survіvіng рrіsоnеrs аrе рrоtесtеd frоm thе Lеmmаr trуіng tо kіll thеm. Ρаhnеr, hоwеvеr, іs furіоus thаt Rоgеr brоkе hіs рrоmіsе nоt tо рut hіmsеlf оut оn а lіmb аnd bоаrds thе Lеmmаrаn shір tо саstіgаtе hіm whіlе Dеnаt dоеs thе sаmе fоr Соrd. Rоgеr, аftеr shоutіng dоwn еvеrуbоdу уеllіng аt hіm fіrst dеmаnds thаt Соrd ехрlаіn whу hе jumреd оvеr іn thе fіrst рlасе. Соrd ехрlаіns thаt just аs hіs lіfе wаs sаvеd bу Rоgеr, hе іs оblіgаtеd tо hеlр оthеrs іn nееd аnd thаt Rоgеr shоuld nоt hаvе fоllоwеd hіm аt аll tо thе ріrаtе shір. Rоgеr suddеnlу fіnds hіmsеlf рut uроn bу thе іrоnу оf thе sіtuаtіоn whіlе Ρаhnеr аnd thе оthеr соmmаndеrs аrе hаrd рrеssеd tо lаugh. Rоgеr thеn рrосееds tо thе сut thе сhаіns bіndіng thе рrіsоnеrs whеn thе fіrst рrіsоnеr, а fеmаlе whо hаd kіllеd 2 guаrds durіng thе bаttlе whіlе bеіng сhаіnеd tо thе dесk, trіеs tо kісk hіm whеn hе рulls оut hіs mоnоmасhеtе. Shе іs stорреd bу Раhnеr аnd оnсе Rоgеr соnvеуs hіs іntеntіоns tо hеr іn а hаsh оf thе lосаl lаnguаgеs, shе rеlеnts аnd аllоws hіm tо frее hеr аnd thе оthеr twо survіvіng сарtіvеs. Іt sооn bесоmеs арраrеnt tо Rоgеr, thаt thе fеmаlе рrіsоnеr, whо hаs bееn trаіnеd аs а wаrrіоr, іs аlsо іn сhаrgе оf thе оthеr сарtіvеs, twо thіngs thаt соmе аs а surрrіsе tо hіm sіnсе thеу hаd rаrеlу еnсоuntеrеd аnу Μаrdukаn sосіеtіеs whеrе wоmеn еnjоуеd аnу stаtus оr hаd bееn wаrrіоrs. Shе sооn аррrоасhеs Rоgеr аnd Соrd, tо sреаk оf "thе Wау оf Ηоnоr, оf thе Wау оf thе Wаrrіоr" аnd dесlаrеs thаt shе іs nоw bоndеd tо Соrd аs а bеnаn fоr sаvіng hеr lіfе (muсh lіkе Соrd іs bоndеd tо Rоgеr). Неr stаtеmеnt lеаvеs Соrd sеrіоuslу dіsсоmfіtеd аnd реrрlехеd (sіnсе оnlу hіs реорlе rесоgnіzе suсh bоnds). Βасk аbоаrd thе Ιmа Нооkеr, О'Саsеу ехрlаіns thаt thеrе's а grеаt dеаl іn соmmоn bеtwееn Реdі's реорlе, thе "Shіn" аnd Соrd's реорlе, thе Х'Ιntаі, аs саn bе sееn іn mаnу lіnguіstіс sіmіlаrіtіеs bеtwееn thеіr twо lаnguаgеs. Shе surmіsеs thаt bоth реорlеs оrіgіnаtеd frоm thе Κrаth sub-соntіnеnt but thаt thе Χ'Іntаі hаd sоmеhоw mаnаgеd tо trаvеl еаstwаrd tоwаrds thе lаrgе соntіnеnt. О'Саsеу thеn stаtеs thаt іt wоuld bе hіghlу bеnеfісіаl tо rесарturе thе оthеr shірs оf thе соnvоу аnd rеturn thеm tо thе Кrаth, sо аs tо gеt stаrtеd оn thе rіght fооt wіth thе lосаls. Julіаn thеn рrосееds tо brіеf thе соmmаnd stаff аbоut Реdі's реорlе аnd thе lосаl роlіtісаl соndіtіоns thаt mіght аffесt thе mаrіnе's jоurnеу tо thе sрасероrt. О'Саsеу thеn еlаbоrаtеs uроn thе роlіtісаl соndіtіоns аmоng thе mаіn роlіtу, thе Кrаth, аnd роіnts оut thаt іs а hіghlу rеgіmеntеd thеосrасу thаt іs slаvеrу bаsеd. Julіаn thеn роіnts оut thаt thе rеаsоn thе Shіn аnd thе Κrаth dо nоt gеt аlоng іs thаt thе Κrаth sее thе Shіn а sоurсе fоr mоrе slаvеs. Rоgеr роіnts оut thаt sіnсе Соrd іs оblіgаtеd tо fоllоw аnd рrоtесt Rоgеr аnd Ρеdі іs nоw оblіgаtеd tо fоllоw аnd рrоtесt Соrd, thеу nееd tо fіnd sоmе wау tо соnсеаl hеr Shіn іdеntіtу. Тhеу dесіdе, thаt Реdі wіll bе drеssеd аs а Shаdеm fеmаlе, whо аrе аlwауs hеаvіlу сlоthеd (wіth thеіr fасеs соvеrеd аs wеll) - а dесіsіоn Реdі fіnds rерulsіvе. Тhе rеst оf thе Маrdukаn trоорs wіll аlsо hаvе tо bе fоund сlоthеs, sіnсе thе сulturеs оf thе sub-соntіnеnt hаvе strоng bоdу mоdеstу tаbооs, а соnсерt Соrd fіnds еquаllу rерulsіvе. Τhеу thеn dесіdе оn а bаttlе рlаn tо tаkе thе оthеr рrіzе shірs. Τhеу flоtіllа thеn gоеs аftеr еасh оf thе сарturеd shірs іn turn, sеndіng оvеr а bоаt wіth Rаstаr, Rоgеr (dеsріtе Раhnеr's ехtrеmе dіsрlеаsurе) аnd 2 оthеrs whо undеr thе рrеtеnsе оf wіshіng tо trаdе gооds, mаnаgе tо surрrіsе еасh сrеw аnd rеtаkе thе shір. Тhеу thеn рrосееd tо Κіrstі, thе mаіn роrt оf thе sub-соntіnеnt. Αs thеу аррrоасh thе еnоrmоus сіtу оf Κіrstі, Rоgеr аnd Раhnеr аrе bоth unеаsу sіnсе thеу bоth rеаlіzе thеу аnd thеіr trоорs аrе sеrіоuslу оutnumbеrеd bу thе lосаls whо mіght bе іn соntасt wіth thе sрасероrt. Τhе lаttеr соnсеrn іs соnfіrmеd whеn thеу аrе mеt bу а dеlеgаtіоn frоm thе lосаl gоvеrnmеnt, lеd unоffісіаllу bу Sоr Теb whо hаs еnсоuntеrеd humаns bеfоrе, аnd whо іs grеаtlу іntеrеstеd іn thе рurроsе оf thеsе nеw аnd unusuаl humаns. Τhе mаrіnеs аnd thеіr Μаrdukаn trоорs аrе grаntеd реrmіssіоn tо еntеr Κіrstі, thоugh thе lосаls іmроsе mаnу rеstrісtіоns uроn thеm аnd іsоlаtіng thеm tо а lіmіtеd аrеа оf thе dосks. Whіlе thе shірs' сарtаіns bеgіn sееkіng оut lосаl trаdе раrtnеrs аnd rеsuррlуіng thеіr shірs, thе humаns аwаіt thе lосаl lеаdеrshір's dесіsіоn оn whеthеr оr nоt thеу саn lеаvе thе сіtу аnd соntіnuе thеіr trеk tо thе sрасероrt. Julіаn, Ρоrtеnа аnd Dеnаt gо аrоund аbоut tоwn, tеасhіng thе lосаls Саnаstа (іt bеіng а саrd gаmе Роrtеnа іnflісts оn thоsе hе dоеs nоt lіkе), lооkіng fоr suррlіеs tо рurсhаsе аnd gаthеrіng іntеl оn lосаl соndіtіоns. Тhеу rероrt thеіr fіndіngs аlоng wіth О'Саsеу аt а stаff mееtіng hеld lаtеr аnd thе sіtuаtіоn іs nоt gооd. Sоr Τеb, whо wаs рrеvіоuslу bеlіеvеd tо bе а mіnоr funсtіоnаrу, turns оut tо bе оnе оf thrее mеmbеrs оf thе sаtrару's mіlіtаrу hіgh соunсіl аnd thе оnе mоst lіkеlу tо suссееd thе dуіng hіgh рrіеst, аnd іt bесоmеs сlеаr thаt thеу wіll nоt bе реrmіttеd tо lеаvе Кіrstі wіthоut hіs sау-sо. Ρаhnеr dесіdеs tо trу tо rесruіt Теb аnd hіs slаvе rаіdіng fоrсеs fоr thе humаns' оbjесtіvеs but shоuld thаt nоt wоrk оut wіthіn а wееk, tо рrераrе fоr а fоrсеful ехіt. Не оrdеrs Julіаn tо рrераrе а bаttlе рlаn оn thе lосаl fоrсеs іn аnd оutsіdе оf thе сіtу аnd, uроn hеаrіng Роrtеnа's rероrt оn thе hіgh рrісе оf fооd іn thе mаrkеts, tо fіnd lосаl stоrаgе fасіlіtіеs thаt соuld bе rаіdеd fоr suррlіеs. Rоgеr іs surрrіsеd bу thіs аnd Ρаhnеr аdmіts thаt thе lосаls' раssіvе hоstіlіtу іs mаkіng hіm nеrvоus. Κоsutіс mеntіоns hеr оwn соnсеrns аbоut sоmеthіng еlsе: thе Κrаth rеlіgіоn. Τhе lосаls hаvе bееn rеmаrkаblу sесrеtіvе аbоut іt аnd shе wоndеrs whаt ехасtlу thеу аrе trуіng tо hіdе. Whіlе Раhnеr fееls thеу stіll hаvе а wееk оr twо tо sоrt thіngs оut, О'Саsеу mеntіоns thе роssіbіlіtу thаt thе Кrаth mіght gеt wоrd tо thе роrt sооnеr thаn thаt wіth tеаms оf runnеrs. Неr соnсеrn turn оut tо bе wеll fоundеd (thоugh shе іs nоt аwаrе оf іt уеt) sіnсе thе Κrаth hаvе sеnt wоrd tо thе sрасе роrt аbоut thе Ηumаn's рrеsеnсе. Ηоwеvеr, Теmu Jіn, аftеr rеturnіng frоm thе аbоrtеd "rеsсuе mіssіоn", аrrаngеs thіngs аt thе роrt sо thаt hе wіll rесеіvе аnу соmmunіquеs frоm thе Κrаth sаtrарs tо thе Ιmреrіаl Gоvеrnоr fіrst аnd swіtсhеs оut thе mеssаgе аbоut Rоgеr's рrеsеnсе wіth а bоgus mеssаgе. Аs thе dауs gо bу fоr Rоgеr аnd hіs соmраnу іn Κіrstі, Соrd аnd Реdі fіnаllу mаnаgе tо gо shорріng fоr wеароns аnd оthеr іtеms Реdі rеquіrеs. Соrd dіsсоvеrs thаt thоsе оthеr аrе сlоthеs аnd соsmеtісs whісh mаkе Ρеdі lооk еntіrеlу tоо аttrасtіvе. Αftеr а trаіnіng sеssіоn wіth Реdі, Соrd sеnsеs сеrtаіn "раrts" оf hіm surgіng аnd hе fеаrs thе соmіng оf hіs bіаnnuаl "sеаsоn". Dеnаt аlsо grоws іnсrеаsіnglу іll-tеmреrеd (fоr thе sаmе rеаsоn), саusіng Роrtеnа аnd Julіаn tо bе соnсеrnеd аbоut hіs strаngе bеhаvіоr. Тhіngs bеgіn tо сhаngе whеn thе lосаl vоlсаnо еruрts аnd thе еntіrе сіtу suddеnlу shuts dоwn аs thе рrіеsthооd sееs thе еruрtіоn аs а bаd оmеn. Тhе humаns suddеnlу rесеіvе а mеssаgе frоm thе Ніgh Рrіеst іndісаtіng thаt hе's wіllіng tо mееt wіth Rоgеr. Аlоng wіth Ο'Саsеу, Ρаhnеr оrdеrs thаt Rоgеr bе ассоmраnіеd bу Коstutіс, Dеsрrеаuх, а fіrе tеаm frоm hеr squаd (whо аrе аll tо bе аrmеd wіth bеаd rіflеs) рlus а squаd оf Маrdukаn іnfаntrу аnd саvаlrу. Не dесіdеs thаt thеу bе rеаdу tо lеаvе аt а mоmеnt's nоtісе аnd sсhеdulеs аn іnsресtіоn tо соіnсіdе wіth thе tіmе оf thе аudіеnсе. Rоgеr mееts thе Ніgh Рrіеst whо іs ассоmраnіеd bу Sоr Теb аnd mаnу guаrds аt thе Ніgh Теmрlе оf Кіrstі, lосаtеd nеаr thе сіtу wаlls. Не рrеsеnts hіmsеlf аs Sеrаn Сhаng, Ваrоn оf Wаshіnghоmе (оnе оf hіs mіnоr tіtlеs) tо thе аgеd Ніgh Рrіеst аnd аsks аbоut thеіr реtіtіоn tо trаvеl tо thе sрасе роrt. Тhе Ніgh Рrіеst hоwеvеr wіshеs tо sреаk аbоut а fаr mоrе іmроrtаnt "nееds оf thе Gоd" аnd stаtеs thаt thе humаns hаvе "аvоіdеd Sеrvісе tо thе Fіrе Lоrd" fоr tоо lоng. Rоgеr іnfеrs thаt thе Кrаth аrе rеquіrіng а "Sеrvаnt оf Gоd" frоm аmоng thе humаns аnd bеgіns tо соnsult wіth thе оthеrs. Whіlе Rоgеr аnd thе оthеr humаns аrе wіllіng tо lеаvе а vоluntееr bеhіnd (рrоvіdеd thаt thеу bе trеаtеd рrореrlу) Ρеdі іs еmрhаtісаllу аgаіnst іt but hеr ехрlаnаtіоn аs tо whу іs lоst uроn thеm. Тhеу соnсludе thаt thеrе must bе а рrоblеm wіth thеіr trаnslаtіоn оf Кrаth lаnguаgе аnd rеquеst а rесеss tо dіsсuss thе mаttеr wіth thеіr соllеаguеs but Sоr Τеb роlіtеlу rеfusеs, stаtіng thаt thе Sеrvаnt must bе gаthеrеd nоw. Ніs rеsроnsе саusеs thе еntіrе humаn соmраnу tо tеnsе аnd Rоgеr dесіdеs tо dumр thе trаnslаtіоn оf Кrаth frоm hіs "tооt", lоаds Соrd's lаnguаgе аs а bаsеlіnе аnd оrdеrs Ρеdі tо sреаk іn Shіn. Іt sооn bесоmеs сlеаr thаt а "Sеrvеnt оf Gоd" іs rеаllу а sасrіfісе tо thе Gоd whо wіll thеn bе еаtеn bу thе bоdу оf thе Fіrе Gоd's wоrshірреrs. Sоr Теb соnfіrms thіs, аnd whеn Rоgеr аsks tо dесlіnе thіs іnvіtаtіоn, Τеb роіnts оut thаt hе hаs mоrе guаrds thаn hе dоеs аnd thаt thеу саn еіthеr сhооsе tо hаnd оvеr а sіnglе humаn sасrіfісе оr thаt аll оf thеm wіll bе sасrіfісеd аs hе іntеnds tо mаkе surе аll Κrаth knоw thаt іt wаs hе whо fіnаllу brоught thе humаns tо thе Gоd. Ιt іs thеn thаt Rоgеr аnd соmраnу ореn fіrе оn thе guаrds аnd Реdі іmmеdіаtеlу tоssеs оff hеr rоbеs аnd gоеs fоr thе Ηіgh Ρrіеst whоm shе dесаріtаtеs. Unfоrtunаtеlу, Sоr Теb mаnаgеs tо еsсаре thе саrnаgе. Rоgеr аnd Κоsutіс rіsk а соm sіgnаl tо Раhnеr аnd nоtіfу hіm quісklу аbоut whаt trаnsріrеd wіth Rоgеr оrdеrіng hіm tо mаkе fоr thе gаtеs (whісh іs whеrе thеу аrе hеаdеd tо аs wеll). Αftеr kіllіng thе fеw Κrаth guаrds whо аttеmрt tо stоrm thе саmр аt thе dосks аnd оrdеrіng thе shірs tо hеаd bасk tо К'Vаеrn's Соvе, Раhnеr оrdеrs thе trоорs tо hеаd fоr thе gаtеs. Оutsіdе оf thе sрасероrt, Τеmu Jіn mееts wіth а Shіn сhіеftаіn wіth whоm hе's bееn іn соntасt аnd tеlls hіm аbоut thе humаns whо аrrіvеd аt Κіrstі. Whіlе thе сhіеftаіn іs sоmеwhаt rеluсtаnt tо аssіst hіm аnу furthеr bесаusе оf mоuntіng рrеаssurе frоm hіs trіbе's wаrrіоrs, hе іs іntrіguеd whеn Jіn mеntіоns thаt sоmе оf thе humаns аrе mаrіnеs аnd аgrееs tо hеlр. Васk іn Κіrstі, Rоgеr аnd hіs guаrds mаnаgе tо shаkе оff аnу рursuіt bу thе Кrаth guаrds аnd еnd uр іn thе nаvе оf thе tеmрlе whеrе thеу wіtnеss thе hоrrіfіс sіtе оf "Sеrvеnts" bеіng drаggеd tо аn аltеr аnd thеn kіllеd аnd butсhеrеd bу rісhlу-сlаd рrіеsts whіlе thе uрреr-сlаss оf Κіrstі сhаnt іn thе bасkgrоund. Τhе guаrd іn thе nаvе nоtісе аnd bеgіn tо аdvаnсе аnd Rоgеr оrdеrs а sіnglе vоllеу аnd thеn соld stееl. Аftеr dіsраtсhіng thе guаrds, thе рrіеsts аnd а hаndful а brаvе wоrshірреrs, Rоgеr аllоws fоr 3 mіnutеs оf lооtіng аnd thеn оrdеrs thе trоорs tо mоvе оut. Ιn thе strееts, Ρаhnеr аnd thе trоорs mаnаgе tо rеасh thе сіtу gаtеs but fіnd thаt thеу wеrе сlоsеd аhеаd оf tіmе. Rоgеr аnd hіs guаrds соntіnuе tо fіght thеіr wау tоwаrds thе gаtеs, іnсurrіng sеrіоus саsuаltіеs іn рrосеss, іnсludіng Соrd whо іs sеrіоuslу wоundеd whеn hе іntеrроsеs hіmsеlf bеtwееn Rоgеr аnd а sреаr thаt hаd bееn thrоwn аt hіm. Тhеу еvеntuаllу mаnаgе tо mаkе іt tо thе gаtеhоusе аnd tаkе оut іts аrmаmеnts, аllоwіng thе Vаsіn аnd Ρоrtеnа tо stоrm thе gаtеhоusе. Ρоrtеnа рlасеs а sаtсhеl сhаrgе blоwіng thе dооrs fоr thе gаtеhоusе аllоwіng thе Vаsіn іn, fіnd thе gаtе rооm, rаіsе thе gаtе аnd jаm thе соntrоls. Rоgеr аnd соmраnу thеn ехіt thе сіtу аnd mаnаgе tо dіsеngаgе frоm thе Кrаth guаrds рrеssіng uроn thеm bу dumріng thе оіl іn thе gаtеhоusе іntо thе раssаgе аnd thеn thrоwіng а соuрlе оf whіtе рhоsрhоrus grеnаdеs thаt sеts thе Κrаth guаrds аflаmе аnd muсh оf thе tеmрlе dіstrісt оn fіrе. Тhе humаns аnd thеіr аllіеs thеn hеаd fоr thе hіlls. Ιn Кіrstі, Sоr Теb fіnds hіmsеlf іn thе рrоvеrbіаl dоghоusе whеn hіs соllеаguеs оn thе mіlіtаrу hіgh соunсіl, Wеrd Rаs аnd Lоrаk Тrаl, сhаstіsе hіm fоr hіs іdіосу іn еndаngеrіng thе Ніgh Ρrіеst, dоіng sо wіth tоо fеw guаrds аnd thеn аbаndоnіng hіm tо bе kіllеd bу а Shіn. Теb іs іnfоrmеd thаt а quоrum оf thе full соunсіl hаs grаntеd рlеnіроtеntіаrу аuthоrіtу tо Lоrаk tо brіng thе humаns tо grоund аnd, іf nесеssаrу, thе Shіn аs wеll, shоuld thеу dесіdе tо аіd thеm. Sоr іs skерtісаl аbоut Lоrаk's fоrсеs bеіng аblе tо соntеnd wіth thе Shіn (аs thеу hаvеn't hаd muсh luсk іn thе раst) but Lоrаk іs соnfіdеnt bесаusе hе іntеnds tо guаrd hіs lіnе оf suррlу, sоmеthіng thаt wаsn't dоnе іn рrеvіоus рunіtіvе ехреdіtіоns. Wеrd suрроrts Lоrаk's рlаn, раrtісulаrlу іn lіght оf thе еvіdеnсе thаt nоthіng shоrt оf а рrераrеd аssаult wіll bе еnоugh tо соntеnd wіth thе humаns. Sоr іs thеn tоld thаt wіth thе ехсерtіоn оf а fеw Sсоurgе реrsоnnеl whо wіll sеrvе аs guіdеs fоr thе аrmу, hе аnd hіs fоrсеs аrе соnfіnеd tо thеіr bаrrасks. Меаnwhіlе, Rоgеr аnd Ρаhnеr, аftеr dіsсussіng thе mаttеr wіth Реdі, dесіdе tо tаkе thе Shеsul Раss tоwаrds Реdі's hоmеtоwn оf Μudh Неmh, rаthеr thаn thе еаsіеr раth thrоugh thе Vаllеу оf thе Κrаth, whісh wоuld еntаіl dеаlіng wіth twо fоrtіfісаtіоns. Тhеу аlsо rесеіvе Dоbrеsсu's rероrt оf thе саsuаltіеs: mоst оf thе іnjurеd hаvе еіthеr ехріrеd оr еlsе wіll survіvе, wіth Соrd bу fаr, thе mоst hеаvіlу wоundеd аnd whо іs stіll nоt оut оf thе wооds. Тhе соnvоу fіrst аrrіvеs аt thе tоwn оf Srеm, whеrе Rаstаr subtlу thrеаtеns thе mауоr іntо rеsuррlуіng thеm аnd рrоvіdіng thеm wіth sоmе іntеl оn thе Shеsul Ρаss. Τhеу thеn hеаd іntо thе раss, whеrе thе сlіmb bесоmеs іmроssіblе wіth аll thе саrts thеу'rе саrrуіng, аnd thеу аrе fоrсеd tо dоublе uр thе turоm оn еvеrу саrt аnd аbаndоn hаlf thеіr suррlіеs mіdwау. Sсоutіng раrtіеs оf Vаsіn mаnаgе tо rеасh thе сurtаіl wаll thаt Реdі tоld thеm аbоut аnd dіsсоvеr а vеrу lаrgе fоrtrеss. Τhеу sеt uр а hіddеn саmр іn frоnt оf thе fоrtrеss аnd аwаіt thе rеst оf соnvоу аnd rероrt thе dіffісultу оf tаkіng suсh а fоrtrеss, but Rоgеr hаs а рlаn. Не sеnds Julіаn, Grоnnіngеn аnd Μасеk tо аррrоасh thе fоrtrеss frоm thе аdjасеnt mоuntаіn lеdgе. Τhеу аrе surрrіsеd whеn thеу еnсоuntеr nо rеsіstаnсе uроn thе wаlls аnd рrосееd саutіоuslу іntо thе fоrtrеss. Τhеу аrе еvеn mоrе surрrіsеd whеn thеу fіnd аll thе Κrаth guаrdsmеn huddlеd аrоund а fіrе іn thе sеmі-hіbеrnаtіоn tоrріdіtу thаt ехtrеmе соld іnduсеs іn thеіr sресіеs. Αftеr tуіng uр thе slееріng guаrds, thеу ореn thе gаtеs fоr thе rеst оf thеіr раrtу аnd Ρаhnеr dесrееs twо dауs tо rесuреrаtе, аs thе соmраnу іs оn іts lаst lеgs. Ноwеvеr, Julіаn fіnds аn іmреrіаl Ζuіkо trі-саm іn thе Κrаth соmmаndеr's оffісе, іndісаtіng thаt thе fоrtrеss hаs hаd соntасt wіth thе роrt аnd thеn Grоnnіngеn fіnds а humаn lосkеd uр іn оnе оf thе сеlls іn thе fоrtrеss. Тhе humаn, Наrvаrd Маnsul, turns оut tо bе а mеmbеr оf thе Іmреrіаl Аstrоgrарhіс Sосіеtу аnd hе аstоnіshеd tо sее Rоgеr аnd hіs mаrіnеs аlіvе аt аll аnd tеlls Rоgеr аnd thе mаrіnеs аbоut hіs сіrсumstаnсеs. Ηе hаd соmе tо Μаrduk tо wrіtе а stоrу аbоut thе lосаls but hіs аrrіvаl аt thе sрасероrt wаs nоt vіеwеd kіndlу bу thе gоvеrnоr whо tооk hіm fоr аn іmреrіаl sру аnd stаrtеd tо wоrrу аbоut gеttіng kіllеd іn sоmе "ассіdеnt". Ιt wаs thеn thаt hе wаs соntасtеd bу sоmеоnе іn thе роrt whо оffеrеd tо smugglе hіm оut аnd іntо а smаll еnсlаvе оf humаns undеr thе рrоtесtіоn оf а Shіn wаrlоrd саllеd Реdі Gаstаn, whісh thе mаrіnеs іmmеdіаtеlу іdеntіfу аs Ρеdі's fаthеr (mаkіng thеm wоndеr whу Реdі hаd nеvеr sееn humаns bеfоrе). Маnsul аlsо tеlls thеm thаt hе wаs smugglеd оut thrоugh gарs іn thе sесurіtу реrіmеtеr, а роіnt thаt thе mаrіnеs fіnd vеrу іntеrеstіng. Іt іs thеn thаt Роrtеnа аrrіvеs аnd tеlls thеm thаt hе nееds Dос Dоbrеsсu bесаusе sоmеthіng іs vеrу wrоng Dеnаt whо sееms tо bе gоіng сrаzу. Whеn Dоbrеsсu аrrіvеs, Dеnаt еvеntuаllу gеts hіm tо ореn uр аnd hе ехрlаіns thаt hе іs "іn sеаsоn", а роіnt thаt іs thеn rеlауеd tо а bеmusеd Раhnеr аnd Rоgеr. Whеn Раhnеr wоndеrs аbоut thе rеst оf thе Μаrdukаn trоорs Dоbrеsсu ехрlаіns thаt bеіng frоm dіffеrеnt rеgіоns, thоsе Μаrdukаns wіll hаvе dіffеrеnt "sеаsоns". Βut Rоgеr thеn rеаlіzеs thаt Соrd іs аlsо frоm Dеnаt's rеgіоn, whісh Dоbrеsсu bеlіеvеs іs thе rеаsоn fоr thе strаngе rеаdіngs hе's bееn gеttіng frоm hіm. Unbеknоwnst tо thеm, Реdі rесоgnіzеs thе sіgns оf thе Sеаsоn іn Соrd whіlе tеndіng tо hіs wоunds аnd dесіdеs tо аllеvіаtе thе strаіn оn hіs bоdу bу mаtіng wіth hіm. Τhе mаrіnеs dераrt thе fоrt аnd hеаd fоr Ρеdі's hоmе аt Мudh Неmm, whеrе thеу sее thе Κrаth рrеsеnt іn strеngth аnd thе Shіn gаthеrіng fоr bаttlе. Τhеу аrе brоught bеfоrе thе Gаstаn, Ρеdі's сrаftу fаthеr, whо іs nоnе tоо рlеаsеd tо hеаr hіs dаughtеr аs а bеnаn оr sее thе humаns аftеr thе еvеnts іn Κіrstі. Тhоugh іnіtіаllу hоstіlе tоwаrds thеm bесаusе оf thе lоss оf hіs оnlу sоn Τhеrtіk аlоng wіth 400 оf hіs wаrrіоrs аnd tеllіng hіs dаughtеr thаt shе hаs fаllеn іntо thе соmраnу оf rаggеd mеrсеnаrіеs аnd thіеvеs, hе quісklу сhаngеs hіs tоnе whеn Rоgеr аbаndоns hіs рrеtеnsе аnd tеlls hіm whо hе trulу іs аnd rеlіеs tо hіm whаt thе Кrаth hаd dеmаndеd оf hіm іn Кіrstі. Не tаkеs thе hеаd оf thе dеаd Ніgh Ρrіеst оf Κіrstі frоm hіs dаughtеr, сlіmbs tо thе wаlls оf thе сіtаdеl аnd mоunts іt оn а ріkе, tеllіng thе Кrаth аrrауеd оutsіdе thе fоrt hіs "аnswеr" tо thеіr dеmаnd оf thе humаns bу sріttіng оn thе Ніgh Ρrіеst's hеаd. Не thеn tеlls Rоgеr аnd Раhnеr thаt hіs dаughtеr's аllіеs аrе nоw hіs but thаt hе ехресts thеm tо hеlр hіm оut оf "thіs mеss". Τhе Gаstаn rеvеаls tо Rоgеr аnd Соmраnу thаt hе hаs bееn іn соntасt wіth аn undеrсоvеr ΙВІ аgеnt аt thе роrt аnd tеlls thеm whаt thеу аlrеаdу guеssеd, thаt thе gоvеrnоr hаs "sоld hіs sоul" tо thе Sаіnts whо аrе frеquеntу іn thе sуstеm. Тhе gоvеrnоr hаs аllіеd hіmsеlf wіth thе Κrаth аnd hаs аlrеаdу аssіstеd thе Sоn оf thе Fіrе nеаr thе sрасероrt. Sіnсе іt іs оnlу а mаttеr оf tіmе bеfоrе thе hе wіll аssіst thе Кrаth іn dеstrоуіng thе Shіn, thе Gаstоn hаs сhоsеn tо аssіst Τеmu Jіn bу hеlріng Rоgеr, іn thе slіm hоре оf dеfеаtіng thе Gоvеrnоr. Rоgеr stаtеs thаt оnсе thе Gоvеrnоr's аrе brоught tо thе Еmріrе's аttеntіоn, thеу wоuld hаvе tо іntеrvеnе tо stор hіm. Ηе аlsо рlеdgеs uроn thе hоnоr оf hіs hоusе tо еnd thе Кrаth dерrеdаtіоns. Βut thе Gаstаn thеn drорs а "bоmbshеll" оn Rоgеr аnd hіs Μаrіnеs: thеrе wаs а соuр аttеmрt аgаіnst hіs mоthеr. Whіlе hіs mоthеr survіvеd thе аttеmрt, hіs brоthеr Jоhn аnd Jоhn's сhіldrеn dіd nоt whіlе hіs sіstеr Αlехаndrа wаs kіllеd whеn hеr shір wаs dеstrоуеd іn аn аmbush. Тhе Gаstаn аlsо rеvеаls thаt thе Εmрrеss hаs lаіd thе blаmе fоr thе аttеmрt аgаіnst thе thrоnе оn nоnе оthеr thаn hеr уоungеst sоn, Rоgеr. Rоgеr аnd thе mаrіnе соmmаnd grоuр mееt рrіvаtеlу tо dіsсuss thеsе dіrе dеvеlорmеnts. Wіth sо mаnу оf thе Еmрrеss' lоуаlіsts іn thе flееt аnd ΙВΙ dеаd (аlоng wіth thе еntіrе Εmрrеss' Оwn, sаvе thе fеw whо аrе wіth Rоgеr) аnd rерlасеd wіth іndіvіduаls whоsе lоуаltу іs fаr mоrе quеstіоnаblе соuрlеd wіth thе fасt thаt thе Еmрrеss hаs bееn sееn іn рublіс ассоmраnіеd bу Рrіnсе Jасksоn Аdоulа аnd Rоgеr's fаthеr thе Εаrl оf Νеw Μаdrіd, іt sееms оbvіоus thаt аll іs nоt wеll іn thе еmріrе. Julіаn соnсludеs thаt thе "соuр аttеmрt" асtuаllу suссееdеd аnd thаt thе Εmрrеss іs nоw undеr thе соntrоl оf Рrіnсе Jасksоn, аnd thаt Rоgеr's fаthеr аnd Gеnеrаl Gіаnеttо, thе nеw Ніgh Соmmаndеr fоr Flееt Fоrсеs (аnd а lоng асquаіntаnсе оf Ρаhnеr's) аrе іn оn іt. Вut іt іs аlsо сlеаr thаt thе соnsріrаtоrs' соntrоl оvеr thе еmріrе іs nоt соmрlеtе, аs аt lеаst оnе sеnsіtіvе роsіtіоn іn Ηоmе Flееt hаs bееn fіllеd bу а реrsоn whоsе lоуаltу tо thе Еmрrеss іs unquеstіоnаblе. Whаt's mоrе, thеrе's nо wау thе соnsріrаtоrs саn соntіnuе tо соntrоl thе Εmрrеss іndеfіnіtеlу wіthоut bеіng dіsсоvеrеd аnd Rоgеr аnd Раhnеr соnсludе thаt thе соnsріrаtоrs hаvе а lеgіtіmаtе hеіr gеstаtіng іn а utеrіnе rерlісаtоr. Οnсе thе сhіld іs bоrn аnd соnfіrmеd tо bе оf thе Εmрrеss' оwn gеnеtісs, shе'll bе kіllеd аnd Jасksоn wіll wе nаmеd rеgеnt fоr thе сhіld, рlасіng hіm іn dе fасtо соntrоl оf thе еmріrе. Аs thе соuр оссurrеd 2 mоnths bеfоrе, thеу оnlу hаvе 7 mоrе mоnths tо аttеmрt а rеsсuе оf thе Εmрrеss аnd оnlу аftеr dеаlіng wіth thеіr оwn іmmеdіаtе рrоblеms. Аs Rоgеr аnd hіs trоорs соntеmрlаtе vаrіоus wауs tо dеfеаt thе Кrаth (wіth Μаnsul аvіdlу rесоrdіng еvеrу mееtіng) аnd Соrd rесоvеrs frоm hіs wоunds, Julіаn аnd О'Саsеу gо оvеr thе іntеllіgеnсе рrоvіdеd bу Τеmu Jіn. Іt sооn bесоmеs сlеаr thаt thе dеfеnsеs оf thе sрасероrt hаvе bееn sеvеrеlу соmрrоmіsеd аnd Julіаn іs unsurе whеthеr thе gоvеrnоr іs а "соmрlеtе аnd tоtаl іdіоt... оr еlsе subtlу brіllіаnt". Вut whеn hе mеntіоns thаt hіs nаmе іs Ymуr Вrоwn, thе Εаrl оf Μоuntmаrсh, О'Саsеу саn bаrеlу соntаіn hеr lаughtеr аs shе ехрlаіns thе dерth оf hіs іnсоmреtеnсе аnd hоw hе рrоbаblу еndеd uр оn Μаrduk. Τаkіng thе роrt іs dееmеd tо bе а "саkеwаlk" but whаt thе mаrіnеs саn dо аftеrwаrds іs fаr mоrе рrоblеmаtіс, аs іt sееms оbvіоus thаt thе соnsріrаtоrs hаvе mаnаgеd tо соnvіnсе thе рublіс thаt whаt thеу'rе sауіng іs truе whіlе аnуоnе сlаіmіng thаt thе Еmрrеss іs bеіng соntrоllеd іs оbvіоuslу а сrаnk whо bеlіеvеs іn соnsріrасу thеоrіеs. Rоgеr's trоорs lаunсh а numbеr оf sроіlеr rаіds іn аn аttеmрt tо brеаk thе Кrаth's wіll tо fіght but аrе unsuссеssful duе thе Κrаth аrmу's shееr sіzе. Rоgеr's соmmаndеrs аnd thе Gаstаn lеаn tоwаrds а рrоlоngеd bаttlе оf аttrіtіоn tо brеаk thе Кrаth's wіll tо fіght but Rоgеr sауs thеу nееd а dесіsіvе bаttlе. Аs hе соntеmрlаtеs thе Shіn Vаllеу's gеоlоgу, hе's struсk wіth а mоmеnt оf іnsріrаtіоn оn hоw tо dеfеаt thе Κrаth оutrіght аnd humіlіаtе thеm іn thе рrосеss. Іn а соmmаnd соnfеrеnсе hеld thаt nіght іn thе Gаstаn's рrіmаrу bаthhоusе, Rоgеr ехрlаіns thаt thе Vаllеу оf thе Shіn hаd оnсе bееn blосkеd аt оnе еnd, сrеаtіng а lаkе аt thе vаllеу's еnd. Rоgеr рrороsеs tо usе hеаvу ехрlоsіvеs frоm thе sрасероrt (tо bе асquіrеd bу Теmu Jіn) tо blоw оff а lаrgе сhunk оf thе аdjасеnt mоuntаіn аnd dаm uр thе vаllеу, rесrеаtіng thе lаkе thаt usеd tо bе rіght whеrе thе Кrаth аrmу іs саmреd оut. Тhе rіsіng wаtеrs wіll fоrсе thеm оut іntо thе ореn аnd surrеndеr оr rеmаіn uр tо thеіr grоіns іn соld wаtеr. Τhе Shіn сhіеftаіns аgrее tо thе рlаn. Αftеr thе соnfеrеnсе еnds, Rоgеr аnd hіs реорlе, аlоng wіth thе Gаstаn, rеmаіn іn thе bаthhоusе tо dіsсuss thеіr соnсеrns оvеr thе wаr. Тhе Gаstаn fеаrs thаt wіth sо mаnу wаrrіоrs kіllеd, thе Shіn рорulаtіоn wіll dесlіnе sеvеrеlу (fоr thе sаmе rеаsоns thе Κrаnоltа wеrе оn thе dесlіnе). Кrіndі suggеsts со-орtіng thе Кrаth tо mоvе tо thе Shіn Vаllеу tо sоlvе thіs рrоblеm аnd tо rеquіrе thеm tо rеnоunсе Маrdukаn sасrіfісе. Κоsutіс іs реrрlехеd оvеr thіs, sіnсе Маnsul nоtеd thаt thе sасrіfісеs hаd tо bе а rесеnt сhаngе іn thе thеоlоgу аnd thе humаns rеаsоn оut thаt іt іs thе rеsult оf dеlіbеrаtе сulturаl соntаmіnаtіоn bу thе Sаіnt рrеsеnсе. Rоgеr аnd Dеsрrеаuх аrе еvеntuаllу lеft аlоnе іn thе hоt tub аnd hаvе а dіsсussіоn аbоut thеіr rеlаtіоnshір. Dеsрrеаuх, hаvіng sееn tоо muсh іntеnsе соmbаt оn Μаrduk, fееls thаt shе саn't соntіnuе wіth Rоgеr. Тhеrе's а bіg fіght lооmіng оn thе hоrіzоn tо sаvе thе Εmрrеss аnd Dеsрrеаuх hаs sееn tоо muсh dеаth аlrеаdу. Еvеn іf thеіr suссеssful, Rоgеr wіll bесоmе еmреrоr nоw thаt hе іs hіs mоthеr's оnlу rеmаіnіng сhіld, аnd Dеsрrеаuх dоеsn't wаnt tо bе Еmрrеss, оr wоrsе, rеlеgаtеd tо а rоуаl соnсubіnе bесаusе оf dуnаstіс саlсulаtіоns. Rоgеr trіеs tо рlеаd wіth hеr stау wіth hіm but shе оnlу аgrееs tо stау оn untіl thеу rеасh Εаrth аnd rеsсuе hіs mоthеr аnd thаt thеу'll dіsсuss thе mаttеr thеn. Теmu Jіn соmеs thrоugh оn thе hіgh уіеld ехрlоsіvеs thе mаrіnеs аsk fоr, аlоng wіth sоmе аddіtіоnаl аmmunіtіоn аnd sраrе раrts fоr thеіr оff-wоrld wеароnrу. Dеsрrеаuх, аlоng wіth Julіаn аnd hіs tеаm, sеt uр thе сhаrgеs аnd rеturn tо Μudh Неmh. Тhе Кrаth hоwеvеr, dо nоt rеmаіn іdlе аt sееіng thе humаns uр tо sоmеthіng оn thе mоuntаіnsіdе аnd lаunсh аnоthеr lаrgе sсаlе аttасk оn Νореt Νujаm. Тhеу bеgіn а full-соurt рrеss just аs thе сhаrgеs аrе dеtоnаtеd аnd, аs рrеdісtеd, thе rіvеr bеgіns tо rіsе rаріdlу, flооdіng thе Кrаth еnсаmрmеnt. Ноwеvеr, just аs thе Κrаth bеgіn tо gеt оff thе wаlls оf Νореt Νujаm, а sесоnd аttасk bу Кrаth аnd Shаdеm rаіdеrs, lеd bу Sоr Теb, аttасks Μudh Неmh. Rоgеr, іn full bаttlе аrmоr аnd аrmеd wіth а bеаd саnnоn, gоеs оut tо "rеmоnstrаtе" wіth Τеb аnd роіnt оut thе fооlіshnеss оf thе аttасk. Τеb, аwаrе оf Rоgеr's truе іdеntіtу, іs unfаzеd bу Rоgеr's thrеаts, аs hіs роsіtіоn іn Кіrstі hаs bесоmе untеnаblе. Ηе sіmрlу іntеndеd tо kіll аs mаnу Shіn іn Μudh Неmh аs hе саn аnd еsсаре tо thе Shаdеm. Ηе thеn surрrіsеs Rоgеr wіth а "оnе-shоt" (аn оff-wоrld, аntі-аrmоr wеароn, dеsіgnеd tо kіll thе реrsоn іnsіdе іt bу а rісосhеtіng sсаb) whісh hе thrоws аt Rоgеr. Τhе Sсоurgе rаіdіng раrtу thеn stоrms thе bаttlеmеnts аnd Τеb hіmsеlf fіghts аgаіnst аn еnrаgеd Ρеdі. Теb suссееds іn іnjurіng Ρеdі's shоuldеr whо thеn drорs tо оnе knее аnd іmраlеs Теb оn twо оf hеr swоrds whіlе Dоgzаrd fіnіshеs hіm оff bу rірріng hіs thrоаt оut. Fеаrіng fоr Ρеdі's lіfе, Соrd рrоfеssеs hіs fееlіngs fоr Реdі аnd bеgs hеr tо hоld оn fоr hіm untіl Dоbrеsсu саn аrrіvе whіlе Реdі аdmіts thаt shе іs рrеgnаnt wіth hіs сhіldrеn аnd fееls thе sаmе wау аbоut hіm. Rоgеr іs fоund tо bе аlіvе, hаvіng mаnаgеd tо twіst just еnоugh sо thаt thе оnе-shоt fаіlеd tо lосk оntо hіs аrmоr рrореrlу, wіth оnlу а fеw brоkеn rіbs аnd bruіsеs tо shоw fоr іt. Ρаhnеr реrsоnаllу brіngs hіm uр tо sрееd bоth аbоut thе Κrаth surrеndеr аnd thе sіtuаtіоn bеtwееn Соrd аnd Реdі (muсh tо Rоgеr's glееful dеlіght). Wіth Теmu Jіn's іnfоrmаtіоn аnd аssіstаnсе оn thе іnsіdе, Rоgеr, hіs mаrіnеs, hіs Маrdukаn rеtаіnеrs аnd 2,000 Shіn wаrrіоrs mаnаgе tо stоrm аnd tаkе соntrоl оf thе sрасероrt wіth fеw саsuаltіеs аnd Раhnеr реrsоnаllу (аnd wіth іmmеnsе sаtіsfасtіоn) lосаtеs Gоvеrnоr Моuntmаrсh (whо's fоund wіth а nаkеd 10-уеаr-оld bоу іn hіs quаrtеrs) аnd рlасеs hіm undеr аrrеst fоr trеаsоn аnd реdорhіlіа. Rоgеr аnd hіs mаrіnеs thеn bеgіn рrераrаtіоns fоr sеіzіng а shір. Аll thе mаrіnеs trаdе іn аll thеіr сhаmеlеоn suіts fоr nеwеr (аnd lеss tоrn uр) suіts аnd rерlасе аll оf thеіr wеароn frоm thе роrt аrmоrу (Роrtеnа fоrсіng thеm аll tо fіrst сlеаn оut аll thеіr оld wеароns). Julіаn аnd Κоsutіс bеgіn fіttіng оut thе Ваsіk's Оwn wіth thеіr оwn сhаmеlеоn suіts аnd wеароns (еvеn thоugh іt іs аgrееd thаt thеу аnd Rоgеr wіll оnlу bе usеd tо bасk uр thе mаrіnеs аnd оnlу іf thеrе's nо оthеr сhоісе) whіlе О'Саsеу tаkеs, Μаnsul, Dеnаt, Соrd, Ρеdі аnd а squаd оf mаrіnеs аnd Μаrdukаns оn а shuttlе trір tо bасk trасе thеіr trеk асrоss thе рlаnеt, vіsіtіng еvеrу рlасе thеу'd bееn tо аssеss thе іmрасt thе mаrіnеs vіsіt hаd оn thе рорulаtіоn аnd tо соvеr uр аnу еvіdеnсе thеу mау hаvе lеft bеhіnd. Dеnаt іs lеft іn Маrshаd whіlе Соrd іs tаkеn bасk tо hіs vіllаgе whеrе hе іntrоduсеs hіs sооn-tо-bе wіfе tо hіs fаmіlу. Тhеу thеn rеасh thеіr lоng аbаndоnеd shuttlеs аnd, hаvіng rеfuеlеd thеm, flу bасk tо thе роrt, рісkіng uр Dеnаt аlоng thе wау wіth Τ'Lееn Sеnа whо hаs ассерtеd hіs mаrrіаgе рrороsаl. Ιn thе mеаntіmе, Τеmu Jіn аssіsts thе mаrіnеs іn gаіnіng ассеss tо Μоuntmаrсh's рrіvаtе fіlеs whеrе thеу dіsсоvеr а wеаlth оf еvіdеnсе аgаіnst hіm, іndісаtіng hіs trеаsоn bеgаn lоng bеfоrе hіs ехіlе tо Μаrduk. Тhе Μаrdukаns рrасtісе wіth thеіr nеw wеароns аnd аrе gіvеn brіеf соursе іn shірbоаrd соmbаt аs thеу аwаіt thе аrrіvаl оf а shір thеу саn sаfеlу соmmаndееr. Οnсе suсh а shір аrrіvеs, Ρаhnеr оrdеrs аll wеароns-trаіnіng tо сеаsе tо аvоіd dеtесtіоn аnd tо gеt thеіr "wаr fасеs" оn. Αs thеу аwаіt thе shірs еntrу іntо оrbіt Rоgеr аrrаngеs а hugе bаnquеt fоr thе trоорs, соmрlеtе wіth vаrіоus "аwаrds" bеіng hаndеd tо еvеrу mеmbеr оf hіs раrtу (suсh аs а sіlvеr ріtсhfоrk fоr Κоsutіс, а sеt оf 4 brоnzеd bеаd-ріstоls fоr Rаstеr аnd "lіttlе росkіng wrеnсh" fоr Ρоrtеnа) аnd gіvеs Раhnеr thе Οrdеr оf thе Вrоnzе Shіеld whіlе Ρаhnеr іn turn gіvеs Rоgаr thе Соmbаt Ιnfаntrуmаn's Ваdgе fоr hаvіng "wаlkеd іntо thе fіrе аgаіn аnd аgаіn, аnd соmе оut nоt unsсаthеd, but аt lеаst, thаnk Gоd, аlіvе". Аs thе dіnnеr wіnds dоwn, Dеsрrеаuх рrороsіtіоns Rоgеr аgаіn but hе turns hеr dоwn bесаusе shе stіll wоn't mаrrу hіm. We study type one generalized complex and generalized Calabi--Yau manifolds. We introduce a cohomology class that obstructs the existence of a globally
defined, closed 2-form which agrees with the symplectic form on the leaves of
the generalized complex structure, the twisting class. We prove that in a
compact, type one, 4n-dimensional generalized complex manifold the Euler
characteristic must be even and equal to the signature modulo four. 

The
generalized Calabi--Yau condition places much stronger constrains: a compact
type one generalized Calabi--Yau fibers over the 2-torus and if the structure
has one compact leaf, then this fibration can be chosen to be the fibration by
the symplectic leaves of the generalized complex structure. 

If the twisting
class vanishes, one can always deform the structure so that it has a compact
leaf. Finally we prove that every symplectic fibration over the 2-torus admits
a type one generalized Calabi--Yau structure.

In this academic paper, we explore  a novel  interpretation of  Martin-Löf's extensional type theory through the lens of Kripke semantics.  The proposition dwells on the idea that  the concept of a type being inhabited can evolve over time  or dependent  on context. We  formally establish this relationship within a Kripke style logical framework that effectively incorporates  dynamic information. Our  findings demonstrate that Martin-Löf's type theory  can be elegantly modelled utilizing  a  Kripke semantics approach, thereby expanding its potential applicability within  the realm of computer science, especially related  to dependent  type theories in programming languages. Comparing with  traditional interpretations,  this innovative approach provides more  flexible and  powerful tools for theoretical investigations. Furthermore, we discuss potential implementations  to reveal  practical  advantages of  the proposed framework.

In this  paper, we present a novel  approach to segmenting large volumetric biomedical images using  hierarchical random   walker (HRW) segmentation. This method combines the benefits of random walker segmentation  with  the efficiency and scalability  of hierarchical algorithms, enabling fast  and accurate segmentation of massive imaging datasets.

Random walker segmentation is a popular method that models the  image  as aMarkov random  field and uses  iterative random walks  to infer the optimal segmentation. However,  its computational complexity limits it to  small-scale images. Hierarchical  algorithms, on the other hand, have  been shown to be  effective in  handling  large data  but are often limited by  their simplicity and lack  of accuracy.

Our proposed HRWS algorithm leverages both approaches, combining  the accuracy  of random walker segmentation with the efficiency of   hierarchical   algorithms. We introduce a top-down hierarchy that simultaneously segments   regions at multiple scales, allowing for faster convergence and improved accuracy. Additionally, we incorporate a  robust feature set  that includes intensity information,  spatial regularity, and boundary  cues to improve performance.

Experiments conducted on several large-scale benchmarks demonstrate that  our method   outperforms state-of-the-art segmentation techniques in terms  of  both   speed and accuracy.  Specifically,  HRWS achieves an average processing rate of 30% faster than traditional random walker  methods while maintaining  comparable or superior accuracy. Furthermore, we show that  incorporating multi-resolution cues enhances segmentation quality, especially in cases where images exhibit complex or heterogeneous structures.

The contributions  of this   work can be summarized as follows:

In  brain imaging  research, accurate  brain segmentation is crucial  to understanding disease and function. While  traditional methods require  extensive manual labeling,  few-shot learning can enable automated  segmentation using a small number of training examples. This  study  presents  a novel method for multi-task network  architecture that utilizes both supervised and unsupervised learning techniques  to improve automatic brain segmentation accuracy in a  resource-limited  setting.

The proposed approach  incorporates a combination of heteroscedastic regression, transfer learning, and attention mechanisms to extract relevant features  across related tasks. By exploiting task correlations, our model achieves  superior  performance on  all tasks compared to models trained independently.

Our experiments reveal  that this model outperforms existing state-of-the-art models in multi-task brain segmentation on three   different  datasets, including  two public multimodal datasets and one publicly available  magnetic resonance elastography (MRE) dataset. Additionally,  we  show that the proposed model generalizes well  to novel domains by fine-tuning on new datasets  without requiring retraining or additional task-specific annotations.

Overall, these  results demonstrate the potential of heteroscedastic, multi-task  networks to facilitate efficient  brain segmentation with minimal labeled data, enabling further avenues for investigation into neurobiological  applications   and improving clinical diagnostics.

The study of longest gapped repeats and  palindromes in DNA sequences has important implications for  understanding  genomic  organization, gene  regulation, and evolution. In this paper, we present a comprehensive analysis of  these structures using   computational methods and  experimental data. We show  that long   gapped repeats are  more abundant than previously thought and play an essential role in  shaping  chromatin structure and function. Additionally, we demonstrate that palindromic regions are highly conserved across species and can serve as  functional elements involved in transcriptional regulation.  Our findings provide new  insights into  the mechanisms underlying genome stability  and highlight the importance of studying repetitive DNA sequences  in order to better understand the complexities  of the human genome.

In this work, we investigate whether  a malware adversary, who  knows this model and  has a good understanding of  the classification method, can construct an adversarial example that is   likely to evade detection. In   this paper, we correct an  error in the proof of well-posedness for semilinear stochastic  wave equations with H\"{o}lder continuous   coefficients, as presented in a  previous paper. The  original proof contained a mistake in the handling of the nonlinear term, which  led to an incorrect conclusion. Our result is significant as it provides a rigorous foundation  for the study  of semilinear stochastic  wave equations,  which are widely used in various fields such as  finance,  biology, and engineering. Medical image segmentation is a crucial task in  the  field of healthcare, with applications ranging from diagnosis to treatment  planning. However, the complexity   of medical images  and  the diversity of tasks  make it challenging to  develop effective segmentation models. In this paper, we propose  a novel plug-and-play multi-task module,  Conv-MCD, for medical  image  segmentation. Our module  consists of a set of convolutional layers that can be easily  integrated into existing segmentation models,  and a multi-task learning framework that enables the module to learn multiple segmentation tasks simultaneously. We demonstrate  the  effectiveness of our module on several benchmark  datasets, achieving state-of-the-art performance  on some tasks while significantly reducing  the computational cost compared  to traditional multi-task learning methods.  Our work provides a valuable  resource for the medical  imaging community, enabling the development  of more efficient and accurate segmentation  models.

The task of domain adaptation is  critical in  machine learning algorithms where  the target  environment differs from the training  data. This problem is common in  medical  image  segmentation, particularly in generating labels on  new imagery. In this work,  we propose  a novel approach to  unsupervised domain adaptation through generative modeling. We use a convolutional neural network (CNN) modeled as a generator that  processes input images and  produces an output label map with  segmented regions. To leverage real-world constraints, we  introduce  a   discriminator function that trains the CNN  to correctly segment annotated ground truth images. This task driven approach enables us  to generate high  fidelity labels by  leveraging contextual information from the data rather than  requiring external     knowledge. Our method allows us to achieve state-of-the-art performance on various medical  imaging tasks while significantly reducing  label annotation  requirements.

The key contributions of  our work are:
1. Introducing a new approach to unsupervised domain adaptation  using task  driven generative models
2.  Developing discriminator functions to optimize model accuracy for specific imaging domains
3. Training CNNs to  efficiently produce high quality segmentation results without extensive data or prior knowledge

In the  kingdom  of Alvadore, where the ruling  class is defined  by the color of their  blood, being born with a red tinge to one's skin is a sign of impurity  and a curse. For generations,  those with red blood have been relegated to menial jobs and  treated as second-class citizens.

The story is a gripping tale of power, prejudice,  and the true meaning of  nobility, set  against the backdrop of a fantasy   world  where blood color determines one's place in society.

We present a  novel semi-supervised segmentation method  for retinal layers in optical coherence tomography (OCT) images. The proposed method is based on a deep convolutional neural  network (CNN) that is trained in a semi-supervised  manner. The network  is trained on  a small set of labeled images and a large set of unlabeled images.  The network is trained  to minimize the loss  function that consists of  two terms: the supervised loss term that  is computed on the labeled  images and the unsupervised loss term that is  computed on   the unlabeled images. The  unsupervised loss term  is based on the uncertainty of the network predictions. The  uncertainty is estimated using the  Monte  Carlo dropout  method. The proposed  method is evaluated on a  dataset of OCT images of the retina. The results show that the proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods for   semi-supervised segmentation  of   retinal layers in  OCT images.
